entries.text_de:
zu Holkham7 n. 228, jetzt Graf Leicester, einst Erzbischof Matth. Parker, dann Oberrichter Edward Coke gehörig.

f. 1—16 vom Ende 16. Jhs. sind dem alten Codex vorgebunden. f. 1—5 Quadr., Arg., u. S. 532, Dm verwandt; f. 6—16 Historisches.

f. 17 (laut älterer Foliirung f. 1) beginnt der um 1200 geschriebene Theil, den Quadripartitus jüngster Ausgabe (s. Hs. m) enthaltend: f. 17 I. II Cnut, u. S. 279; f. 34 Af-Ine, u. S. 17; f. 55 I As, u. S. 147; f. 56 II As, u. S. 151; f. 60b Episc, u. S. 477; f. 61b—62b Norðleod; Mirce; Að; Had, u. S. 459. 463. 465; f. 63 Blas, Forf, u. S. 389; f. 63b Hu, u. S. 192; f. 64b IV As, u. S. 171; f. 66 V As, u. S. 167; f. 67 III As, u. S. 170; f. 68 VI As, u. S. 173; f. 72 Ordal, u. S. 386; f. 73 I Atr, u. S. 217; III Atr, u. S. 228; f. 75 Pax; Wal, u. S. 391. 393; IV Atr, u. S. 232; f. 77 II Atr, u. S. 220; f. 80b Duns, u. S. 375; f. 82 VII Atr, u. S. 260; f. 83b Iudex, u. S. 474; f. 84b II. III Eg, u. S. 195; f. 86 AGu, u. S. 127; f. 87 App AGu, u. S. 394; f. 87b EGu, u. S. 129; f. 89b I. II Ew, u. S. 139; f. 91b I Em, u. S. 185; f. 92 III Em, u. S. 190; f. 93 II Em, u. S. 187; f. 94 Swer, u. S. 397; f. 94b Wif, u. S. 443; f. 94b Wer, u. S. 393; f. 95b Wl lad, u. S. 483; f. 96 Geþyncðo, u. S. 457; f. 97 Rect, u. S. 444; f. 100b CHn cor, u. S. 521; f. 102 Quadr. II 4—8, 3, u. S. 544; f. 104 De archidiaconibus, in meinem Quadripartitus S. 163 ff.; f. 104b Hn com, u. S. 524.

Andere Hand um 1200 nach (für Rubrik?) freien Zeilen f. 105 Pseudo-Ulpianus De edendo1. Hiermit schliesst der früheste, einst selbständige Theil des Bandes.

f. 117—40, um 1570 geschrieben aus C, IV Eg Lat, u. S. 207; . . . f. 129v. Epistola Eleutherii Lucio, aus der Londoner Interpolation zu ECf 11, 1 B, u. S. 636; . . . f. 138 ECf retr Rubriken, u. S. 670.

f. 141—57, um 1230 geschrieben, enthalten Leis Wl unvollständig, u. S. 492; f. 144b ECf2, u. S. 627; f. 154 Cons Cn unvollständig, u. S. 618.

Der Rest ist wieder kurz vor und um 1600 geschrieben.
entries.text_en:
at Holkham7 no. 228, now belonging to the Earl of Leicester, formerly to Archbishop Matth. Parker, then to Chief Justice Edward Coke.

ff. 1—16, of the end of the 16th century, are bound in front of the old codex. ff. 1—5 Quadr., Arg., below, p. 532, related to Dm; ff. 6—16 historical matter.

At f. 17 (by the older foliation f. 1) begins the part written c. 1200, containing the Quadripartitus in its latest edition (see MS m): f. 17 I. II Cnut, below, p. 279; f. 34 Af-Ine, below, p. 17; f. 55 I As, below, p. 147; f. 56 II As, below, p. 151; f. 60b Episc, below, p. 477; ff. 61b—62b Norðleod; Mirce; Að; Had, below, pp. 459. 463. 465; f. 63 Blas, Forf, below, p. 389; f. 63b Hu, below, p. 192; f. 64b IV As, below, p. 171; f. 66 V As, below, p. 167; f. 67 III As, below, p. 170; f. 68 VI As, below, p. 173; f. 72 Ordal, below, p. 386; f. 73 I Atr, below, p. 217; III Atr, below, p. 228; f. 75 Pax; Wal, below, pp. 391. 393; IV Atr, below, p. 232; f. 77 II Atr, below, p. 220; f. 80b Duns, below, p. 375; f. 82 VII Atr, below, p. 260; f. 83b Iudex, below, p. 474; f. 84b II. III Eg, below, p. 195; f. 86 AGu, below, p. 127; f. 87 App AGu, below, p. 394; f. 87b EGu, below, p. 129; f. 89b I. II Ew, below, p. 139; f. 91b I Em, below, p. 185; f. 92 III Em, below, p. 190; f. 93 II Em, below, p. 187; f. 94 Swer, below, p. 397; f. 94b Wif, below, p. 443; f. 94b Wer, below, p. 393; f. 95b Wl lad, below, p. 483; f. 96 Geþyncðo, below, p. 457; f. 97 Rect, below, p. 444; f. 100b CHn cor, below, p. 521; f. 102 Quadr. II 4—8, 3, below, p. 544; f. 104 De archidiaconibus, in my Quadripartitus p. 163 ff.; f. 104b Hn com, below, p. 524.

Another hand, c. 1200, after lines left blank (for a rubric?): f. 105 Pseudo-Ulpianus De edendo1. With this the earliest part of the volume, once independent, ends.

ff. 117—40, written c. 1570 from C, IV Eg Lat, below, p. 207; . . . f. 129v. Epistola Eleutherii Lucio, from the London interpolation to ECf 11, 1 B, below, p. 636; . . . f. 138 ECf retr rubrics, below, p. 670.

ff. 141—57, written c. 1230, contain Leis Wl, incomplete, below, p. 492; f. 144b ECf2, below, p. 627; f. 154 Cons Cn, incomplete, below, p. 618.

The rest is again written shortly before and around 1600.

wormald.other_contents: Smallest of the set; supplemented by other legal texts; extensive additions by Parker's circle; Ine rubrics moved to front of code, full rubrication (pp. 238, 242).
wormald.overview: A small copy of the final Quadripartitus recension from the third quarter of the twelfth century, matching M in content and order, to which other scribes later added further legal texts. It belonged to Archbishop Parker, whose circle added to it extensively, and then to Sir Edward Coke, whose descendants kept it at Holkham Hall; it is now in the British Library. Wormald treats Coke's ownership as a sign of how long this Latin collection went on being used.
wormald.key_quote: It is more than symbolically significant that one of the surviving copies belonged to Sir Edward Coke (p. 244)
wormald.doubts: GUIDE: the guide gives 'Holkham Hall (Earl of Leicester), MS 228'; Wormald gives the current shelfmark BL, Additional MS 49366. Note the n. 305 wording 'following ... Liebermann himself in placing Hk before T' – so Liebermann's relative order agrees, though the guide's date c. 1200 vs T c. 1225 is later than Wormald's.
